name: HC14c Lost to follow-up
description: Counts ART clients with no subsequent clinical contact or ARV pick-up after their expected return date who were documented as lost to follow-up or as having missed their drug pick-up
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary",
    "mamba_fact_arv_orders"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.return_visit_date >= :startDate
  AND a.return_visit_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND x.encounter_date > a.return_visit_date
        AND x.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_arv_orders o
      WHERE o.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND o.voided = 0
        AND o.date_activated > a.return_visit_date
        AND o.date_activated < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )

  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
          WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
            AND (
                s.lost_to_followup IS NOT NULL
                OR (
                    s.date_lost_to_followup IS NOT NULL
                    AND s.date_lost_to_followup <> ''
                )
            )
      )
      OR a.interruption_reason = 'MISSED DRUG PICK UP APPOINTMENT'

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.return_visit_date >= :startDate
  AND a.return_visit_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND x.encounter_date > a.return_visit_date
        AND x.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_arv_orders o
      WHERE o.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND o.voided = 0
        AND o.date_activated > a.return_visit_date
        AND o.date_activated < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  )

  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
          WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
            AND (
                s.lost_to_followup IS NOT NULL
                OR (
                    s.date_lost_to_followup IS NOT NULL
                    AND s.date_lost_to_followup <> ''
                )
            )
      )
      OR a.interruption_reason = 'MISSED DRUG PICK UP APPOINTMENT'
  );
